name: sidebar-islands
title: Sidebar islands
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A collapsed rail, an expanded island, and a tree flyout for CRM navigation. The host persists collapse, the active item, and the team.

meta.descriptionEs: Riel contraído, isla expandida y submenú en árbol. El anfitrión guarda el equipo, la sección activa y si el panel está contraído.

examples.title: Taller Norte
examples.description: Equipo, búsqueda, badges, informes anidados y el menú de Camila Ortega.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: Cincuenta filas, tres niveles, RTL, hoja de 390 px, carga, vacío y error.

meta.usage:
<SidebarIslands
  sections={sections}
  teams={teams}
  teamId={teamId}
  onTeamChange={setTeamId}
  collapsed={collapsed}
  onCollapsedChange={setCollapsed}
  activeId={activeId}
  onNavigate={setActiveId}
/>

api.name: sections
api.description: id, label, icon, badge, hidden, and items. NavItem repeats that shape, plus href or onSelect, and children.

api.name: collapsed / onCollapsedChange
api.description: Controlled rail. The host persists it. defaultCollapsed covers the uncontrolled case.

api.name: activeId / onNavigate
api.description: The current item. onNavigate receives the id. href follows only when onNavigate is omitted.

api.name: teams / teamId / onTeamChange
api.description: Team switcher. The host persists the id.

api.name: status / onRetry / onEmptyAction
api.description: Skeleton, empty copy with a first action, or an error that says what failed and how to retry.

api.name: profile / meter / utilities / onSearch
api.description: Account popover, usage line, footer items, and the search button. Omit any of them to hide that part.

api.name: labels / locale / layout
api.type: SidebarIslandsLabels / es-MX | en / auto | rail | sheet
api.description: Spanish labels are the default. sidebarIslandsLabelsEn is the English set. auto uses a sheet at 480px.

api.name: className / railClassName / panelClassName / previewClassName / itemClassName
api.description: Slot classes. Width and labels stay overridable. No theme tokens are added.

docs: Clean-room. The idea comes from a public post with no license and no code (see NOTICE). Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite avatar, badge, button, empty, popover, separator, sheet, skeleton, tooltip, tree-nav, or workspace-switcher. The flyout composes TreeNav. The team row composes WorkspaceSwitcher. The profile popover is local because UserMenu does not compile under exactOptionalPropertyTypes. Hover preview does not move focus. Below 480px a tap opens a sheet. The host persists collapsed, activeId, and teamId. No theme, cssVars, or fixed colors ship with the item.
